subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

He would prefer to speak with __you in persona.__
solution:
The correct answer is option (1) i.e. **‘you in person’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"In person" **means a meeting or conversation that occurs directly between individuals, typically face-to-face. (एक बैठक या बातचीत जो सीधे व्यक्तियों के बीच आमने-सामने होती है)
